notes.title: Playing Ruins of the Forgotten Demo
notes.notes:
Hello, I'll be participating in my game's demo at the upcoming Steam festival. In Ruins of the Forgotten (ROTF), players take on the role of a Forest Ranger, lost in a jungle altered by a mysterious anomaly during an animal tagging mission. The game blends open-world survival and survival horror as players must manage their thirst, hunger, and health while uncovering the dark mysteries of the jungle.
